title: Daytime showcase: open the cupola, climb out, and enter through its hatch
caption: WINTER PLAYTEST / CUPOLA CLIMB OUT AND BACK IN
historical_scope: Current Act 1 winter Playtest and original Tiger assemblies. Initial tank position and station are declared scenario setup. Enemy fire is held for a controls demonstration; this is not a combat or historical reconstruction.
limitations: Authored input sequence only until the current-build runtime receipt passes and the first-person video and ordinary captured audio are reviewed. Do not publish failed or missing mechanics as a successful showcase.
input_audit: One continuous first-person take. Named gaze actions rotate the current head toward source geometry only. LMB opens/closes the real cupola grip; Space exits and enters its real aperture with a release between holds. The short exterior mouse sweep is ordinary head-look. No mount, dismount, position, station or hatch-state action is injected during the timeline. The initial commander station is setup; this clip demonstrates roof-to-interior entry, not a ground-to-hull climbing sequence.
visual_acceptance: The original cupola grip and lid stay attached while opening and closing.
Space climbs onto solid turret geometry; the exterior pause shows the actual winter surroundings from normal human eye height.
The second Space press enters through the visible open aperture without crossing solid armor or dropping through the floor.
The clip ends seated inside with the cupola closed and no hidden cuts or camera replacement.
